customManagers.description: Version-pinned tools installed by CI via `uv tool install <name>==<version>`, annotated with a `# renovate:` comment on the preceding line.

packageRules.description: Group non-major GitHub Actions updates, including the digest bumps that `helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests` produces. Digest pinning is why a non-existent tag (astral-sh/setup-uv@v10) cannot reach a workflow again: a SHA either resolves or the pin PR fails, instead of the workflow failing to resolve at run time.

Group non-major updates to the version-pinned tools the custom manager above finds. Without this rule they match neither of the two rules that set `automerge`, since those name the `github-actions` and `cargo` managers, so every such bump waits for a human however green it is -- which is what left a passing prek PR open. A CI tool is the case where green CI is the strongest possible evidence: the tool's own job is what runs it, so a bump that breaks it fails the run that would have merged it.

Major updates: one PR per package, reviewed by a human. Deviates from the `hole` repo, which auto-merges majors on the strength of its CI. Goetia's three platform backends do not exist yet, so a major bump of e.g. windows-service would land with almost no behavioural coverage. Revisit once the backends and their integration tests are in.
